modelspec.observatory.ServeAddress.title: ServeAddress
modelspec.observatory.ServeAddress.description: The value of `modelspec train --serve <addr>` (epic:training-observatory, In scope, first bullet), a loopback socket address `<ip>:<port>` with an IPv4 address in 127.0.0.0/8, `[::1]` or `localhost` (127.0.0.1), so the stream is reachable from this machine only (epic, Out of scope, no remote access beyond localhost). Port 0 lets the system choose. Any other address is a usage error. Once bound the process prints `serving http://<bound address>/events` on stderr; stdout is what a run without the flag prints.
